description: This file defines the ContentViewModel class which manages the state and logic for a SwiftUI view, coordinating with an AgentService to run an agent based on user input, and providing UI-related data such as icons, colors, and titles for different agent steps.

classes.name: ContentViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class for managing UI state and interactions for a SwiftUI view, including running an agent, handling user input, and representing agent steps visually.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ContentViewModel with optional dependency injection for AgentService and sets up publishers to observe changes.

methods.name: startAgent
methods.description: Starts the agent process with user input after validating that input is not empty.

methods.name: clearSteps
methods.description: Clears the current agent steps and resets related UI state.

methods.name: getStepIcon
methods.description: Returns a system icon name based on the AgentStep step type.

methods.name: getStepColor
methods.description: Returns a Color value corresponding to the AgentStep step type.

methods.name: getStepTitle
methods.description: Returns a descriptive title string for a given AgentStep step type.
